purpose: Owner-requested dated source checkpoint, technical traceability and rollback
historyPolicy: Actual capture date; existing historical commits retained; no backdating or invented creation/completion dates
scope: Versionable source, project documents, data definitions and eligible assets. Ignored machine state, credentials, third-party downloads and large local experiment data remain local. See manifest for exact included files.
validation: Archival and structure checks only; no new runtime/product/clinical validation claimed
provenance: Prepared with AI assistance at the explicit request of the account owner; authorship and third-party notices preserved
secretReview: High-confidence credential patterns checked in eligible source/docs; credential files and machine state excluded. No perfect-secret-detection claim.
recoveryScope: Files in manifest are the checkpoint. Local-only files and ignored assets require the preserved local files or their independently licensed source; hashes alone cannot restore their contents.
